properties.displayName: AlertEvent ASIM filtering parser for Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring
properties.query:
// Schema: AlertEvent 1.0.0. Source: Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring (CCF).
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    hostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    username_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    attacktactics_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    attacktechniques_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    threatcategory_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    alertverdict_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventseverity_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    SalesForceRealTimeEventMonitoring_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime
    | where isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime
    | where EventType in (
        "ApiAnomalyEventStore", "CredentialStuffingEventStore",
        "GuestUserAnomalyEventStore", "LoginAnomalyEventStore",
        "ReportAnomalyEventStore", "SessionHijackingEventStore",
        "UniversalAnomalyEventStore")
    | extend
        _SourceType = EventType,
        _RawIp = iff(EventType == "SessionHijackingEventStore", coalesce(CurrentIp, SourceIp), SourceIp),
        _Org = tostring(column_ifexists("SalesforceDomain", ""))
    | extend
        _OrgHost = tostring(parse_url(iff(_Org contains "://", _Org, strcat("https://", _Org))).Host),
        DvcIpAddr = iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(_RawIp)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_RawIp)), _RawIp, "")
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(EventDate, TimeGenerated),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(EventDate, TimeGenerated),
        EventCount = toint(1),
        EventVendor = "Salesforce",
        EventProduct = "Real-Time Event Monitoring",
        EventSchema = "AlertEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventOriginalType = _SourceType,
        EventOriginalSubType = AnomalySubType,
        EventType = "Alert",
        EventSubType = "Anomaly",
        EventResult = "NA",
        // The source has no normalized severity or analyst verdict.
        EventSeverity = "Informational",
        EventUid = coalesce(EventIdentifier, SalesforceObjectId, EventUuid),
        EventOriginalUid = SalesforceObjectId,
        EventMessage = Summary,
        AlertName = case(
            _SourceType == "ApiAnomalyEventStore", "Salesforce API anomaly",
            _SourceType == "CredentialStuffingEventStore", "Salesforce credential stuffing",
            _SourceType == "GuestUserAnomalyEventStore", "Salesforce guest user anomaly",
            _SourceType == "LoginAnomalyEventStore", "Salesforce login anomaly",
            _SourceType == "ReportAnomalyEventStore", "Salesforce report anomaly",
            _SourceType == "SessionHijackingEventStore", "Salesforce session hijacking",
            "Salesforce universal anomaly"),
        AlertVerdict = "Unknown",
        DetectionMethod = "Behavioral Analytics",
        ThreatCategory = "Unknown",
        ThreatOriginalCategory = coalesce(AnomalySubType, _SourceType),
        Dvc = coalesce(DvcIpAddr, "Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring"),
        DvcScope = _OrgHost,
        DvcOriginalAction = PolicyOutcome,
        DvcAction = case(
            PolicyOutcome in ("Block", "MeteringBlock"), "Deny",
            PolicyOutcome == "EndSession", "Terminate",
            PolicyOutcome in ("NoAction", "ExemptNoAction", "MeteringNoAction", "Notified"), "Allow",
            ""),
        Username = UserNameDetail,
        UsernameType = iff(isempty(UserNameDetail), "", iff(UserNameDetail contains "@", "UPN", "Simple")),
        UserIdType = iff(isempty(UserId), "", "SalesforceId"),
        UserScope = _OrgHost,
        UserSessionId = SessionKey,
        RuleName = coalesce(PolicyId, Policy),
        AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
            "Score", Score, "SecurityEventData", SecurityEventData,
            "SourceIp", SourceIp, "CurrentIp", CurrentIp, "PreviousIp", PreviousIp,
            "CurrentPlatform", CurrentPlatform, "PreviousPlatform", PreviousPlatform,
            "CurrentScreen", CurrentScreen, "PreviousScreen", PreviousScreen,
            "CurrentWindow", CurrentWindow, "PreviousWindow", PreviousWindow,
            "CurrentUserAgent", CurrentUserAgent, "PreviousUserAgent", PreviousUserAgent,
            "UserAgent", UserAgent, "LoginKey", LoginKey, "PolicyOutcome", PolicyOutcome,
            "Operation", Operation, "QueriedEntities", QueriedEntities,
            "RowsProcessed", RowsProcessed, "RequestIdentifier", RequestIdentifier,
            "Uri", Uri, "AnomalySubType", AnomalySubType,
            "EvaluationTime", EvaluationTime), dynamic({})),
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        UserEntityKey = "",
        FileEntityKey = "",
        ProcessEntityKey = "",
        UserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([])
    | extend
        AlertId = EventUid,
        AlertDescription = EventMessage,
        IpAddr = DvcIpAddr,
        User = Username,
        Rule = RuleName
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or DvcIpAddr in (ipaddr_has_any_prefix) or has_any_ipv4_prefix(DvcIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where array_length(hostname_has_any) == 0
    | where array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or Username has_any (username_has_any)
    | where array_length(attacktactics_has_any) == 0
    | where array_length(attacktechniques_has_any) == 0
    | where array_length(threatcategory_has_any) == 0 or ThreatCategory in~ (threatcategory_has_any)
    | where array_length(alertverdict_has_any) == 0 or AlertVerdict in~ (alertverdict_has_any)
    | where array_length(eventseverity_has_any) == 0 or EventSeverity in~ (eventseverity_has_any)
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount,
        EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
        EventOriginalType, EventOriginalSubType, EventType, EventSubType,
        EventResult, EventSeverity, EventUid, EventOriginalUid, EventMessage,
        AlertId, AlertName, AlertDescription, AlertVerdict, DetectionMethod,
        ThreatCategory, ThreatOriginalCategory,
        Dvc, DvcIpAddr, IpAddr, DvcScope, DvcOriginalAction, DvcAction,
        Username, UsernameType, User, UserId, UserIdType, UserScope, UserSessionId,
        RuleName, Rule, AdditionalFields,
        DvcEntityKey, UserEntityKey, FileEntityKey, ProcessEntityKey,
        UserAdditionalIds, AdditionalEntities
};
parser()
